contract.title: Threat Hunter Dashboard Visual Unification REWORK 1
acceptance_criteria: Only frontend/src/components/topbar/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx and frontend/src/components/topbar/WorkspaceSwitcher.test.tsx may change; no CSS, Topbar, dashboard, Registry, routing, workspace, backend, provider, runtime or environment file may change.
Clicking the closed WorkspaceSwitcher trigger opens the menu and clicking the same trigger again closes it.
Selecting an enabled workspace uses the existing setWorkspace boundary and canonical workspaceRoutes mapping, performs navigation and closes the menu after the menu action is processed.
A pointer interaction outside both the WorkspaceSwitcher trigger and menu immediately closes the menu without preventing, consuming or otherwise blocking the outside target action.
Pointer interactions inside the trigger and menu boundary are not treated as click-away and menu-item actions complete before dismissal.
Escape closes an open menu without changing workspace or route.
Outside-interaction and Escape listeners are active only while needed and are removed on close and component unmount; repeated open and close cycles do not accumulate listeners.
Existing SOC WORKSPACES, MANAGEMENT WORKSPACES and SYSTEM / ADMINISTRATION grouping, CISO / ISO naming, current identity, purple selected state, checkmark and aria-current remain unchanged.
Existing WorkspaceId values, workspaceRoutes, setWorkspace and navigate boundary, Back and Forward behavior and URL authority remain unchanged.
The TASK-0123 Threat Hunter dashboard, truthful Active Hunts state and canonical persisted Hunt Hypotheses behavior remain byte-identical.
No global click workaround may block propagation or default behavior; use a component-local boundary and standard React DOM listener lifecycle without CSS or global shell changes.
Focused WorkspaceSwitcher tests cover open, repeat-trigger close, outside pointer dismissal, preserved outside action, inside interaction, selection navigation and close, Escape and listener cleanup.
Existing WorkspaceSwitcher grouping and routing tests, Topbar and cross-workspace regressions, Back and Forward behavior, URL authority and TASK-0123 dashboard regressions remain passing.
Full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass; Scope Guard reports exactly the two authorized files and the TASK-0123 reference hash remains unchanged.
The original Architect Implementation Review PASS remains historical; REWORK 1 requires a new Architect Implementation Review and explicit Product Owner Live Acceptance before DONE.
Do not transition TASK-0123 to DONE or create TASK-0124.
